verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a founders track covering O-1A, EB-2 NIW, E-2 and similar visas, plus free Deel HR access for those customers. Neither is a startup-ecosystem program: nothing documents YC or accelerator partnerships, VC-portfolio arrangements, or founder-community pricing. A bundled free HR perk is an adjacent feature, not the ecosystem pricing or partnership the story asks for, so the verdict stays at none.
